KEA VAO Result 2026 has been released on 19 October 2026 by the Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) for the Village Administrative Officer (VAO) recruitment examination under the Residual Parent Cadre (RPC). The RPC written examination was conducted on 4 October 2026. The recruitment covers 572 vacancies, including 505 RPC vacancies and 67 Kalyana-Karnataka (KK) vacancies. Candidates can check their provisional examination scores through the official recruitment portal and submit objections with supporting documents before 10:00 AM on 22 October 2026. The result link, provisional score notice, objection instructions and recruitment details are provided below.

KEA VAO Result 2026 Download Link

KEA has published the provisional score list for Village Administrative Officer candidates who appeared in the RPC examination on 4 October 2026.

Candidates can access their results through the official Karnataka recruitment website. The provisional score list is subject to the objection process and should not be treated as the final appointment merit list.

KEA VAO Provisional Merit List 2026

The Karnataka Examinations Authority has released the provisional score list for the RPC cadre. This follows the examination held on 4 October 2026 and the provisional answer key published on 6 October 2026.

The provisional score publication gives candidates an opportunity to review their marks and raise any objections with supporting evidence within the prescribed deadline.

After considering eligible objections, the authority may publish revised scores or subsequent merit-list information according to the recruitment rules.

How to Check KEA VAO Result 2026?

Candidates can access their results through the official KEA recruitment portal by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official KEA website at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in.
  2. Open the recruitment or Village Administrative Officer section.
  3. Find the link for VAO RPC Provisional Result 2026.
  4. Open the official RPC VAO result portal.
  5. Enter the application number and date of birth if requested.
  6. Complete any additional verification displayed on the page.
  7. Submit the required details.
  8. Check the provisional examination score displayed for your application.
  9. Download or save the result for future reference.

KEA VAO Result 2026 Objection Last Date

KEA has provided an opportunity for candidates to raise objections against the provisional RPC scores.

The last date to submit objections is 22 October 2026, before 10:00 AM.

How to Raise Objections Against KEA VAO Result 2026?

Candidates who identify discrepancies in the provisional scores can submit their representations through the official objection facility.

  1. Visit the official KEA website.
  2. Locate the VAO RPC provisional result objection notice.
  3. Open the official objection submission facility.
  4. Enter the required registration and personal details.
  5. Select the relevant examination and paper details.
  6. Explain the discrepancy in the published provisional score.
  7. Attach relevant supporting documents or evidence.
  8. Review the entered information before submission.
  9. Submit the objection before the prescribed deadline.
  10. Keep the submission confirmation for reference, if generated.

  5. Document Verification

Details to Check in KEA VAO Result 2026

After opening their result, candidates should verify the information available through the official scorecard or result document.

  • Candidate name
  • Registration number or application number
  • Examination roll number, where displayed
  • Applicable recruitment cadre
  • Examination marks
  • Kannada language test status, where applicable
  • Other result or verification remarks issued by KEA

KEA VAO Document Verification 2026

Document verification will be conducted according to the further shortlisting instructions issued by the Karnataka Examinations Authority.

The document verification dates were not confirmed in the available 19 October result reports.

Candidates should keep the applicable documents ready, including:

  • SSLC or Class 10 certificate for date-of-birth verification
  • Educational qualification certificates and marksheets
  • Valid photo identity proof
  • Applicable caste or reservation certificates
  • Submitted recruitment application form
  • Examination result or scorecard
  • Any additional documents specified in the official verification notice

What Happens After KEA VAO Result 2026?

Following the release of the RPC provisional score list, KEA has invited objections until 22 October 2026 before 10:00 AM.

After completing the objection review, the authority may issue subsequent revised score or merit-list notices. Shortlisting and document verification will be governed by the applicable recruitment rules.

Candidates should regularly monitor the KEA website for the final merit list, cut-off information and document verification schedule.

The result PDFs available for the examined subjects include written examination marks and candidate details. The publication of these documents does not by itself confirm that every listed candidate has qualified for document verification or received a final appointment recommendation.

The official recruitment directorate will issue the applicable shortlisting, document verification and final selection instructions according to its recruitment rules.

Candidates should avoid treating the highest or lowest marks visible in a result PDF as an official selection cut-off. The final cut-off, where issued, should be checked from the recruitment directorate's official notice.

An additional marks notice was published on 15 October 2026 for candidates whose marks had previously been withheld. Candidates can check the latest HPSC HCS result status, download official marks PDFs, verify their roll numbers, review written and interview marks, and follow the final selection list updates below.

HPSC HCS Withheld Marks Notice 2026

The commission's marks list dated 8 October 2026 contained entries for candidates whose results were withheld. A further notice concerning marks of previously withheld candidates was issued on 15 October 2026.

Candidates affected by the earlier withheld status should consult the latest notice on the official HPSC results page. They should verify their individual status directly from the relevant commission document.

HPSC HCS Final Merit List 2026

The final HPSC HCS selection list is distinct from the Main Examination result and the marks list of interviewed candidates.

The Main Examination result identifies candidates provisionally shortlisted for the Viva-Voce. The subsequent marks document reports their examination performance but does not, by itself, establish that a candidate has been recommended for appointment.

The final selection list, when officially issued, should be checked for the names or roll numbers of recommended candidates, applicable categories and other selection details published by HPSC.

How to Check HPSC HCS Final Result 2026?

Candidates can check the latest official result and marks notices by following these steps:

  1. Visit the Haryana Public Service Commission website at hpsc.gov.in.
  2. Open the Examination or Results section.
  3. Find the notices for HCS (Executive Branch) and Other Allied Services Examination-2025 under Advertisement No. 22/2026.
  4. Open the required result, marks or final recommendation notice.
  5. Download the relevant official PDF.
  6. Use Ctrl + F or the PDF search function.
  7. Enter your roll number and check the matching entry.
  8. Read the PDF heading to confirm whether it is a Mains result, marks list or final selection notice.
  9. Save the document for future reference.

HPSC HCS Mains Result 2026

HPSC declared the HCS Main Examination result on 17 September 2026 for the written examination conducted from 27 to 29 June 2026.

The Mains result identified candidates provisionally qualified to appear for the Personality Test. The shortlisted candidates were required to satisfy the applicable eligibility conditions.

The Mains result was not the final selection list.

HPSC HCS Prelims Result and Revised Result 2026

Earlier in the recruitment process, the commission conducted the Preliminary Examination on 26 April 2026 and published result-related notices in May and June.

Result Event Date

The preliminary result and revised result relate to shortlisting for the next examination stage and do not represent final selection.

HPSC HCS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The Haryana Civil Services recruitment process includes the following examination stages:

  1. Preliminary Examination
  2. Main Written Examination
  3. Viva-Voce / Personality Test
  4. Applicable eligibility and document verification formalities
  5. Final recommendation and appointment procedures under the recruitment rules

The Preliminary Examination serves as a screening stage. The published marks framework for the later stages totals 675 marks, consisting of 600 written marks and 75 interview marks.

How to Check RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026

  1. Visit the official RBI website, rbi.org.in, or the Opportunities Portal at opportunities.rbi.org.in.
  2. Go to the "Opportunities @ RBI" section and open "Current Vacancies" → "Results".
  3. Click on the link for the RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 (Panel Year 2025).
  4. Download the result PDF to your device.
  5. Open the PDF and press Ctrl+F to search for your roll number.
  6. If your roll number appears in the list, you have qualified for the Language Proficiency Test.

What After RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026?

Candidates shortlisted in the Mains Result must now appear for the Language Proficiency Test (LPT), the final stage of the RBI Assistant selection process. The LPT tests a candidate's ability to read, write, speak, and understand the official/local language of the RBI office for which they applied. Candidates who studied the relevant local language up to the 10th or 12th standard are generally exempted; others must appear for and clear the LPT to remain in contention for final selection. The LPT is qualifying in nature no marks from it are added to the final merit list, but clearing it is mandatory. RBI is yet to announce the exact LPT schedule, venue, and reporting-time details for this cycle; candidates should watch the official portal for this notification.

RBI Assistant Selection Process 2026

  • Preliminary Examination: Qualifying stage only. Prelims marks are not counted towards the final merit list.
  • Main Examination: The Mains score is what decides a candidate's final rank and selection.
  • Language Proficiency Test (LPT): Qualifying stage. Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the local/regional language of the RBI office applied for. There is no interview stage in this recruitment.

BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2027: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) has announced 660 Artisan Grade-IV vacancies under Advertisement No. 01/2026. Recruitment is being conducted for Fitter, Welder, Turner, Machinist, Electrician, Electronics Mechanic and Foundryman trades across nine manufacturing units. Candidates with Class 10, a National Trade Certificate (NTC/ITI) and a National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in the respective trade can apply online from 21 October to 18 November 2026. Selected candidates will initially receive Rs. 24,000 per month during the one-year temporary period.

Total Vacancies 660

Minimum Marks 60% for General/OBC and 55% for SC/ST in both NTC/ITI and NAC, subject to notified conditions

Job Location Nine BHEL Manufacturing Units Across India
Official Website careers.bhel.in

Important Eligibility Notice: Candidates must possess both the prescribed NTC/ITI and NAC qualifications in the relevant trade. Only full-time regular courses are accepted. Applicants can select only one manufacturing unit and one trade. Selected Artisan Grade-IV employees must serve at their allocated manufacturing unit for at least 20 years, during which transfer requests will not be entertained.

BHEL Artisan Eligibility Criteria 2027

Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess all three of the following qualifications in the relevant trade:

  1. Class 10 or Matriculation.
  2. National Trade Certificate (NTC/ITI).
  3. National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC).

The qualification cut-off date is 1 October 2026. Candidates must have obtained the required ITI/NTC and NAC certificates or marksheets by this date.

Minimum Marks Requirement

Category Minimum Marks
General and OBC 60% in both NTC/ITI and NAC
SC and ST 55% in both NTC/ITI and NAC, subject to the applicable reservation conditions

Only full-time regular courses will be considered. The National Apprenticeship Certificate must be issued by the competent authority.

Special Condition: SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying against vacancies not reserved for their respective categories will be considered under general merit standards, without relaxation in the minimum educational percentage. Eligible Ex-servicemen claiming prescribed trade equivalency may receive the notified exemption from minimum marks requirements.

Desirable Language Knowledge

Knowledge of the regional language is desirable for manufacturing units in Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka. Hindi knowledge is desirable for the other manufacturing units.

Eligible Jammu and Kashmir Domiciled Candidates (1980–1989) 5 Years

Maximum Age Ceiling: The age of a candidate, including all permissible relaxations, must not exceed 56 years as of 1 October 2026.

Applicants claiming work-experience-based relaxation must submit the relevant experience certificate in the format prescribed by BHEL.

BHEL Artisan Salary 2027

Selected candidates will initially work as Temporary Artisans for one year with consolidated monthly wages of Rs. 24,000.

Employment Stage Salary / Pay Scale
Temporary Artisan - First Year Rs. 24,000 per month
Artisan Grade-IV After Regularization Rs. 29,500 - 65,000

Upon successful completion of the temporary period, candidates will be regularized in the Artisan Grade-IV establishment according to the prevailing company rules. Applicable allowances will be provided as per the rules in force at regularization.

BHEL Artisan Selection Process 2027

Selection is conducted through a two-stage process consisting of a Computer Based Examination followed by Document Verification and a qualifying Skill Test.

  1. Stage I: Computer Based Examination (CBE).
  2. Stage II: Document Verification and Skill Test.
  3. Final Merit: Based on CBE marks among candidates found eligible in document verification and qualified in the Skill Test.

Candidates are generally shortlisted for the Skill Test in the ratio of 1:3 against the available category-wise vacancies for the relevant unit and trade. For a single vacancy in a trade/category, up to five candidates may be shortlisted.

Computer Based Examination Minimum Qualifying Marks

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
UR/EWS 40%
OBC (NCL), SC and ST 30%

For eligible PwBD and Ex-servicemen candidates, the notification permits further qualifying-mark relaxation under specified conditions, subject to minimum standards of 30% for UR/EWS and 22.5% for OBC/SC/ST.

The Skill Test is qualifying in nature. Final merit is determined by CBE marks after successful completion of document verification and the Skill Test.

BHEL Artisan Exam Pattern 2027

The BHEL Artisan Computer Based Examination will contain 120 multiple-choice questions carrying 120 marks, with a duration of 90 minutes.

Subject Questions Marks
Trade-Related Questions 70 70
Engineering / Calculations 30 30
Reasoning 20 20
Total 120 120
  • Examination Mode: Computer Based Examination
  • Question Type: Objective Multiple Choice
  • Total Questions: 120
  • Total Marks: 120
  • Examination Duration: 90 Minutes
  • Correct Answer: 1 Mark
  • Incorrect Answer: Deduction of 0.25 Mark
  • Languages: Hindi, English and one selected regional language option

The examination will be trilingual. Candidates may choose Hindi, English or a notified regional language such as Kannada, Telugu or Tamil. Where the English and Hindi versions differ, the English version will be treated as authentic.

BHEL Artisan Syllabus 2027

According to the official examination pattern, candidates will be tested in three areas:

Section Coverage
Trade Knowledge Technical knowledge associated with the candidate's selected trade
Engineering / Calculations Engineering-related calculations and knowledge assessed in the examination
Reasoning Reasoning ability

The supplied examination pattern document specifies the number of questions for each section but does not provide a detailed chapter-wise syllabus. Candidates should follow any subsequent trade-specific syllabus or examination instructions published by BHEL.

The prescribed application and processing fees are non-refundable. Additional banking or payment transaction charges may apply depending on the payment method.

BHEL Artisan Posting and Transfer Conditions

Selected candidates must serve at their allocated manufacturing unit for at least 20 years from the date of joining. Requests for transfer or change in place of posting will not be entertained during the first 20 years.

The notification also specifies that any transfer considered in exceptional personal circumstances would be subject to availability of a suitable position and other company conditions.

Applicants should therefore choose the manufacturing unit carefully, considering long-term employment and location preferences.

How to Apply for BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2027

  1. Visit the official BHEL Careers website at careers.bhel.in.
  2. Find Artisan Recruitment 2027 - Advertisement No. 01/2026.
  3. Read the detailed recruitment advertisement and examination instructions.
  4. Check the unit-wise and trade-wise vacancies, qualification requirements and age conditions.
  5. Select the appropriate one manufacturing unit and one trade.
  6. Follow the online registration and application instructions provided on the recruitment portal.
  7. Enter the required personal, qualification, category and contact information accurately.
  8. Submit the relevant supporting information and documents according to the portal requirements.
  9. Pay the applicable examination and processing fees using the prescribed online payment facility.
  10. Ensure that both the application submission and fee transaction are successful.
  11. Retain the submitted application and payment confirmation for future reference.

Important: If multiple online applications are submitted by the same candidate, only the last submitted application will be considered final. Applicants should ensure that the selected trade, manufacturing unit and category are correct before final submission.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have announced 1,688 vacancies for 12th-pass candidates under CEN No. 07/2026. The recruitment includes Commercial cum Ticket Clerk, Accounts Clerk cum Typist, Junior Clerk cum Typist and Trains Clerk posts. Online applications open on 15 October 2026 and close on 13 November 2026 at 11:59 PM through the unified RRB recruitment website.

This Railway NTPC 2026 Undergraduate recruitment offers initial basic pay of Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 21,700, depending on the post. Candidates aged 18 to 30 years as on 1 January 2027, with applicable relaxations, can apply if they meet the Class 12 qualification and medical requirements. Selection includes CBT-1, CBT-2, document verification and medical examination. No separate typing skill test will be conducted under CEN 07/2026. Candidates should check the post-wise vacancies, age limit, application fee, RRB preferences and examination pattern before applying.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 Overview

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Eligibility Criteria 2026

Applicants for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 must have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognized board. The notification normally requires at least 50% aggregate marks, but specified candidates are exempt from this minimum-percentage condition.

Qualification Cut-off: The required educational qualification must be completed by 13 November 2026. Candidates awaiting final examination results are not eligible to apply.

Is 50% Required in Class 12 for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

Normally, candidates must secure at least 50% aggregate marks in Class 12. However, the minimum 50% condition is not applicable to the following candidates:

  • Scheduled Caste candidates.
  • Scheduled Tribe candidates.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities.
  • Ex-Servicemen.
  • Candidates possessing qualifications higher than Class 12.

Can Graduates Apply for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

Yes. Candidates with qualifications higher than Class 12 can apply for the undergraduate posts if they satisfy the prescribed age, medical and other eligibility conditions. The 50% Class 12 minimum marks condition is not insisted upon for such candidates.

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate application fee is Rs. 500 for general applicants and Rs. 250 for the eligible concessional categories listed in the notification. Part or all of the examination fee is refundable, after deduction of applicable bank charges, only to candidates who appear in the first-stage CBT.

RRB NTPC Examination Fee Refund Rules 2026

  • Only candidates appearing in CBT-1 are eligible for the prescribed refund.
  • The refund is subject to deduction of applicable bank charges.
  • Refunds are processed to an Aadhaar-seeded bank account as provided in the notification.
  • Candidates must ensure their bank account is correctly linked with Aadhaar.
  • Rejected or incomplete applications do not qualify for a fee refund.

Important: Economically Backward Class (EBC), Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Other Backward Class (OBC) are different categories. EBC concession is based on the conditions specified in the notification and does not itself provide job reservation.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Selection Process 2026

The recruitment process consists of two Computer Based Tests, followed by document verification and medical examination. Unlike several previous NTPC recruitment cycles, CEN 07/2026 does not require a separate Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist or Accounts Clerk cum Typist.

  1. CBT-1: First-stage Computer Based Test for all four posts.
  2. CBT-2: Second-stage Computer Based Test for shortlisted candidates.
  3. Document Verification: Verification of original educational, identity, category and other required documents.
  4. Medical Examination: Candidates must pass the prescribed medical fitness standard for their allotted post.

Is There a Typing Test in RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

No. The Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist and Accounts Clerk cum Typist has been dispensed with under CEN 07/2026. Candidates are still expected to possess basic computer and adequate typing proficiency, which may be assessed after joining.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT-1 Exam Pattern 2026

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate first-stage CBT contains 100 objective-type questions for 100 marks. The examination duration is 90 minutes, and one-third of a mark is deducted for every incorrect answer.

Candidates who have undergone LASIK or another procedure to correct refractive error are not eligible for posts requiring A-3 medical standards under this notification. For B-2 and C-2 posts, eligibility is subject to the medical conditions specified in the official notification.

How to Apply Online for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must submit only one online application through the unified official RRB website from 15 October to 13 November 2026. Candidates must carefully choose the RRB and their post preferences because important details cannot be changed later.

  1. Visit https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in/.
  2. Open the recruitment link for CEN No. 07/2026 - NTPC Undergraduate.
  3. Read the detailed notification, Annexure A and RRB-wise vacancy tables in Annexure B.
  4. Click Create an Account if you are a new applicant. Candidates who already created an RRB account for earlier CENs should use their existing login credentials.
  5. Register using the required personal details, active mobile number and email address.
  6. Complete Aadhaar or other permitted identity verification as directed by the application portal.
  7. Choose one Railway Recruitment Board.
  8. Enter the required personal, educational and reservation details.
  9. Select eligible posts, Railway Zones and Production Unit preferences carefully.
  10. Complete the live photograph capture as instructed by the portal.
  11. Upload the scanned signature and applicable supporting documents.
  12. Review the information and declaration carefully.
  13. Pay the prescribed examination fee using the available online payment method.
  14. Submit the application and retain the confirmation details.

Important: The selected RRB and details entered during Create an Account cannot be modified later. Candidates must not submit multiple applications.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Photo and Signature Requirements 2026

The RRB application process includes live photograph capture and upload of the candidate's signature. Candidates should follow the exact instructions to avoid application rejection.

  • Follow the portal's instructions for face positioning, lighting and identity matching.

IREL Tradesman Trainee Eligibility Criteria 2026

Applicants must possess the prescribed educational qualification and two years of relevant experience in their selected trade by 9 November 2026.

Post-Wise Educational Qualification and Experience

Trade Educational Qualification Experience
Fitter ITI / National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in Fitter trade 2 years in the Fitter trade or discipline in a reputed industrial establishment, including eligible on-the-job or apprenticeship training
Electrician ITI / NAC in Electrician trade and a valid statutory licence 2 years in the Electrician trade or discipline in a reputed industrial establishment, including eligible on-the-job or apprenticeship training
Instrumentation ITI / NAC in Instrumentation trade 2 years in the Instrumentation trade or discipline in a reputed industrial establishment, including eligible on-the-job or apprenticeship training
Attendant Operator Chemical Plant (AOCP) ITI / NAC in Attendant Operator (Chemical Plant) OR 10+2 Science (Intermediate/Higher Secondary) with Chemistry as one of the subjects and at least 50% aggregate marks 2 years in the operation of chemical and allied process industries, including eligible apprenticeship training

Important: The AOCP post provides an alternative 10+2 Science eligibility route with Chemistry and a minimum of 50% aggregate marks. Candidates applying through this route must still satisfy the two-year relevant experience requirement.

IREL Internal Candidates

Existing employees on IREL's regular rolls are eligible under the special educational qualification route of SSC with four years of experience in the relevant trade or operation, subject to the notification's other conditions.

Experience Requirements

  • Two years of relevant post-qualification experience is required for external applicants.
  • Apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961, will be counted toward relevant experience.
  • On-the-job training may be included where it meets the relevant trade conditions.
  • Teaching or Research Fellowship experience is not accepted as relevant post-qualification work experience.
  • Prescribed qualifications must be obtained through full-time regular courses recognized by the applicable competent authorities.
  • Applicants must provide valid experience documentation when required for verification.

The advertisement also requires good communication and behavioural skills and knowledge of working in an automated environment, including proficiency in office automation tools.

Selected candidates will undergo one year of training and receive a consolidated stipend of Rs. 34,200 per month.

Benefits During Training

  • Consolidated monthly stipend of Rs. 34,200.
  • House Rent Allowance at the applicable posting-location rate, calculated on the minimum basic pay of Rs. 22,000, if company bachelor accommodation is not provided.
  • Medical facilities for the trainee and eligible dependent family members as applicable to W-3 grade employees.

Pay and Benefits After Training

On successful completion of training, trainees may be absorbed as regular Tradesmen in W-3 Grade, carrying the pay scale of Rs. 22,000–88,000.

Eligible regular employees may receive Industrial Dearness Allowance, HRA, increments, medical facilities, leave encashment, incentives, uniforms, provident fund, gratuity and other benefits according to company rules.

Salary Clarification: The approximate annual CTC of Rs. 6.5 lakh applies after absorption into regular employment and is calculated using an assumed 20% HRA for a Y-class city. It is not the training-period salary or guaranteed in-hand pay.

IREL Tradesman Trainee Selection Process 2026

The selection process consists of a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill Test or Trade Test and document verification.

  1. Computer Based Written Examination.
  2. Shortlisting for the Skill Test in the ratio of 1:5 based on CBT merit.
  3. Qualifying Skill Test / Trade Test or Computer Proficiency Test, as applicable.
  4. Preparation of unit-wise, trade-wise and category-wise merit lists using CBT marks.
  5. Document Verification.
  6. Pre-employment Medical Examination and other prescribed verification.

Final Merit Rule: Only candidates qualifying in the Skill Test will be considered for final selection. Final merit will be determined using CBT marks only. Skill Test marks will not be added to the final merit.

IREL Tradesman Trainee Exam Pattern 2026

The written examination will be a Computer Based Test containing 150 multiple-choice questions for 150 marks. The examination duration is two hours, and there is no negative marking.

Section Subject Questions Marks

Section II General Knowledge, Logical Reasoning, Numerical Ability and English 50 50
Total 150 150

The notification identifies two main examination sections: professional trade knowledge and general aptitude.

General Knowledge General Knowledge
Logical Reasoning Logical Reasoning

English English Language

The detailed advertisement specifies the subjects and question distribution but does not provide a separate chapter-wise technical syllabus. Candidates should prepare according to their notified trade and any subsequent official examination instructions.

IREL Tradesman Trainee Job Location 2026

Vacancies are available at IREL units in Odisha, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh.

The initial posting location will be based on the unit selected by the candidate during the online application. Requests to change the selected initial posting location will not be entertained.

Transfer Condition: After appointment, employees are liable to be transferred to any IREL unit, office or project site in India. Applicants must be willing to serve anywhere in the country.

How to Apply for IREL Tradesman Trainee Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official IREL website at www.irel.co.in.
  2. Open the recruitment announcement for Tradesman Trainee - Advertisement No. CO/HRM/36/2026.
  3. Read the detailed advertisement and application instructions.
  4. Select the relevant recruitment registration link.
  5. Complete registration using a valid personal email address and mobile number.
  6. Verify the email address and mobile number using the separate OTPs sent by the portal.
  7. Record the generated Application Sequence Number and password.
  8. Log in and complete the personal, communication, qualification and experience details.
  9. Select only one eligible trade and one IREL unit/location.
  10. Upload the required certificates, photograph and signature.
  11. Check all entered information using the Preview option.
  12. Complete final submission and pay the applicable application and processing fees online.
  13. Save the payment acknowledgement and download or print the submitted application form.

Application Warning: Candidates can edit their application details only before final submission. Once submitted, the form cannot be edited. Applicants must not apply for more than one trade or unit.

The advertisement specifically states that candidates do not need to send printed applications or documents to IREL by post or in person.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Recruitment 2026: Satish Dhawan Space Centre SHAR (SDSC SHAR), under the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), has invited online applications for 97 vacancies under Advertisement No. SDSC SHAR/RMT/03/2026. Posts include Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Library Assistant A, Nurse B, Technician B, Draughtsman B, Fireman A, Light Vehicle Driver, Heavy Vehicle Driver and Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS). Eligible candidates with 10th, ITI, Diploma, Graduation or other prescribed qualifications can apply online from 19 October to 9 November 2026.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Recruitment 2026 Overview

Organization Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
Recruitment Centre Satish Dhawan Space Centre SHAR (SDSC SHAR)
Advertisement Number SDSC SHAR/RMT/03/2026
Notification Date 19 October 2026
Post Names Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Library Assistant A, Nurse B, Technician B, Draughtsman B, Fireman A, Light Vehicle Driver A, Heavy Vehicle Driver A and Multi-Tasking Staff
Total Vacancies 97
Qualification 10th Pass, ITI/NTC/NAC, Diploma, B.Sc., Graduation, Library Science Master's Degree or Nursing Diploma, depending on the post
Age Limit 18–35 Years for most posts; 18–25 Years for Fireman A and MTS
Salary / Pay Scale Pay Level 1 to Level 7, depending on the post
Selection Process Written Test, Skill Test or Physical Efficiency Test, depending on the post
Application Mode Online
Application Start Date 19 October 2026, 10:00 AM
Application Last Date 9 November 2026, 11:59 PM
Job Locations Sriharikota, Rasayani, Balasore and Secunderabad, depending on the post code
Official Application Website apps.shar.gov.in

Important Eligibility Notice: The educational qualification, age limit, selection stages and posting location vary by post code. Candidates applying for Technical Assistant posts must possess a first-class Diploma of at least three years' duration. Technician B posts require the specified NCVT trade qualifications. Driver posts require valid licences and prescribed experience. Applicants must meet the eligibility requirements for their selected post code by 9 November 2026.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

ISRO SDSC SHAR Recruitment 2026 Important Links

Apply Online ISRO SDSC SHAR Online Application Portal

ISRO SDSC SHAR Eligibility Criteria 2026

Applicants must possess the prescribed post-specific educational qualifications and other eligibility conditions by the application closing date.

Post-Wise Educational Qualification

Post Name Educational Qualification
Technical Assistant First Class Diploma of minimum three years' duration in the relevant engineering discipline from a recognized institution
Scientific Assistant - Physics First Class B.Sc. with Physics as main subject and Mathematics and Chemistry as ancillary subjects
Scientific Assistant - Photography / Cinematography First Class Bachelor of Fine Arts (Photography) or Visual Arts (Cinematography)
Library Assistant A First Class Graduation and First Class Master's Degree in Library Science, Library and Information Science or recognized equivalent
Nurse B First Class Diploma in Nursing of at least three years, recognized by State/Central Government, with registration in the respective State Nursing Council
Technician B SSLC/SSC Pass with ITI/NTC/NAC from NCVT in the notified trade
Draughtsman B SSLC/SSC Pass with NCVT ITI/NTC/NAC in Draughtsman (Civil)
Fireman A 10th Pass and prescribed Physical Fitness and Endurance Test standards
Light Vehicle Driver A 10th Pass, three years of experience as Light Vehicle Driver and valid Light Vehicle Driving Licence
Heavy Vehicle Driver A 10th Pass, five years of driving experience including at least three years as Heavy Vehicle Driver, valid Heavy Vehicle Driving Licence and Public Service Badge where required
Multi-Tasking Staff Matriculation / SSLC / SSC or equivalent Pass

Driver Experience Requirements

For Light Vehicle Driver A and Heavy Vehicle Driver A posts, the prescribed experience must have been gained after obtaining a valid driving licence.

  • Experience certificates must be issued by Government/Semi-Government agencies, registered companies, societies, trusts or other eligible organizations.

  • Heavy Vehicle Driver candidates must satisfy the specified Public Service Badge conditions.

These approximate monthly figures represent basic pay plus DA at the minimum pay level. HRA and Transport Allowance are governed by applicable Government of India rules. Other benefits are subject to ISRO service conditions.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Application Fee 2026

The notification prescribes different processing fees according to the post code. All applicants must initially pay the specified processing fee online.

Post Codes Initial Payment Refund for Women/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-servicemen Attending Written Test Refund for Other Candidates Attending Written Test
07–15 Rs. 750 Rs. 750 Rs. 500
16–30 Rs. 500 Rs. 500 Rs. 400

For post codes 07–15, the effective application fee after refund is Rs. 250 for other candidates and nil for the exempt categories. For post codes 16–30, it is Rs. 100 for other candidates and nil for the exempt categories, provided they appear in the written examination and meet the refund conditions.

Important Fee Refund Condition: The refund is available only to candidates who appear in the Written Test. Candidates absent from the examination will not receive a refund. Applicants must enter their bank account details accurately to receive any eligible refund.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Selection Process 2026

The selection procedure differs according to the notified post.

Post Category Selection Stages
Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Library Assistant A Written Test and Qualifying Skill Test
Technician B and Draughtsman B Written Test and Qualifying Skill Test
Nurse B Written Test and Qualifying Skill Test
Fireman A Written Test, Physical Efficiency Test and Detailed Medical Examination
Light Vehicle Driver A / Heavy Vehicle Driver A Written Test and Qualifying Skill Test
Multi-Tasking Staff Written Test

For posts with qualifying skill or physical tests, the final merit is prepared according to the written examination performance of candidates who qualify in the required subsequent stages.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Exam Pattern 2026

Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Library Assistant A, Technician B and Draughtsman B

Total Questions 80 MCQs
Written Test Duration 90 Minutes
Maximum Marks 80
Correct Answer +1 Mark
Incorrect Answer -0.33 Mark
Skill Test 100 Marks, Qualifying Nature

The minimum written-test qualifying marks are 32 out of 80 for unreserved candidates and 24 out of 80 for eligible candidates against reserved posts. The minimum qualifying marks for the skill test are 50 out of 100 for unreserved candidates and 40 out of 100 for eligible candidates against reserved posts.

Nurse B and Fireman A Written Test

Total Questions 80 MCQs
Duration 120 Minutes
Maximum Marks 80
Correct Answer +1 Mark
Incorrect Answer -0.33 Mark

Nurse B candidates must qualify in the prescribed skill test. Fireman A candidates must qualify in the Physical Efficiency Test and Detailed Medical Examination under the standards specified in the advertisement.

Light Vehicle Driver and Heavy Vehicle Driver Written Test

Subject Questions
Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 50
Elementary English - 8th Standard Level 15
Elementary Arithmetic - 10th Standard Level 15
General Knowledge 20
Total 100

The examination duration is 120 minutes, with one mark for each correct answer and a deduction of 0.25 mark for each incorrect answer. The subsequent driving skill test is qualifying in nature.

Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Exam Pattern

Total Questions 100
Total Marks 100
Duration 90 Minutes
Negative Marking 0.25 Mark per Incorrect Answer

The MTS examination covers Numerical and Mathematical Ability, Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving, General Awareness, and English Language and Comprehension.

ISRO SDSC SHAR Job Location 2026

Selected candidates may be posted at the following ISRO facilities depending on their post code and vacancy availability.

Post Codes Notified Posting Location

30 ADRIN, Secunderabad, Telangana
Remaining Posts SDSC SHAR, Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh

Applicants for posts with multiple notified locations must provide their order of posting preference. Allocation is based on merit, preference and vacancy availability. Selected candidates are also subject to all-India transfer liability within ISRO/Department of Space.

How to Apply for ISRO SDSC SHAR Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official SDSC SHAR website at www.shar.gov.in or the application portal at apps.shar.gov.in.
  2. Open Advertisement No. SDSC SHAR/RMT/03/2026.
  3. Read the detailed notification and identify the post code matching your qualifications.
  4. Open the online application and enter the required personal, educational and contact information.
  5. Provide a valid email address and mobile number.
  6. Select the relevant post code and posting preferences, where applicable.
  7. Upload the photograph, signature and required supporting documents according to the portal specifications.
  8. Review all application details carefully.
  9. Pay the applicable processing fee through the online payment facility.
  10. Complete the application submission by 9 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.
  11. Save the generated Registration Number and application details for future reference.

Multiple Post Codes: Candidates eligible for more than one post code must submit separate applications and pay the prescribed fee separately for each post code.

Department of Financial Service is recruiting candidates for 20 Presiding Officer posts under its 2026 recruitment notification. Eligible applicants must submit the offline application through proper channel to Under Secretary (DRT), Department of Financial Services on or before 9 November 2026. The prescribed qualification for the post requires a District Judge or Member of Indian Legal Service in Grade I or above, and the pay is as per Tribunal (Conditions of Service) Rules, 2021. Applicants must fill up the application in the prescribed format and attach attested copies of CR/APAR dossiers for the last five years as specified in the recruitment advertisement.

Department of Financial Service Presiding Officer at a Glance

Particulars Details
Organisation Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
Advertisement No. F. No. 07/09/2026-DRT
Post(s) Presiding Officer in Debts Recovery Tribunals (DRTs)
Vacancies 20
Pay As per Tribunal (Conditions of Service) Rules, 2021 as amended from time to time
Qualification District Judge or Member of the Indian Legal Service in Grade I or above
Job Location Various Debts Recovery Tribunals across India
Apply By Post
Last Date 09.11.2026 latest by 5:00 PM

Where and How to Send

Duly filled in original applications in the prescribed format should reach the Under Secretary (DRT), Department of Financial Services, 3rd Floor Jeevan Deep Building, Sansad Marg, New Delhi-110001 latest by 5:00 PM on or before 09.11.2026.

Applications of eligible and willing officers are requested through proper channel (wherever applicable).

Posts, Eligibility and Pay

Vacancies are available for the post of Presiding Officer across 20 Debts Recovery Tribunals: (1) Debts Recovery Tribunal-3, Mumbai, (2) Debts Recovery Tribunal-2, Chandigarh, (3) Debts Recovery Tribunal, Allahabad, (4) Debts Recovery Tribunal, Lucknow, anticipated vacancies of Presiding Officer at (5) Debts Recovery Tribunal -1, Chandigarh, (6) Debts Recovery Tribunal, Visakhapatnam, (7) Debts Recovery Tribunal -1, Hyderabad, (8) Debts Recovery Tribunal, Cuttack, (9) Debts Recovery Tribunal -1, Ernakulam, (10) Debts Recovery Tribunal -1, Bengaluru, (11) Debts Recovery Tribunal -2, Ernakulam, (12) Debts Recovery Tribunal, Guwahati, (13) Debts Recovery Tribunal, Pune, (14) Debts Recovery Tribunal -3, Chandigarh, (15) Debts Recovery Tribunal, Dehradun, (16) Debts Recovery Tribunal -1, Kolkata, (17) Debts Recovery Tribunal, Patna, (18) Debts Recovery Tribunal, Nagpur, (19) Debts Recovery Tribunal, Siliguri, (20) Debts Recovery Tribunal -1, Chennai along with any unforeseen vacancies in any of the other Debts Recovery Tribunals across the country which may arise up to 30.04.2027.

Educational Qualification and Eligibility

  • A person shall not be qualified for appointment as Presiding Officer of Debts Recovery Tribunal, unless he is, or has been, a District Judge, or is, or has been a member of the Indian Legal Service in Grade I or above.
  • Notwithstanding anything contained in Rule 3, a person holding or has held the post of Chairperson or Member, as the case may be, of any Tribunal shall be eligible for re-appointment.
  • Where the person appointed as a Chairperson or a Member is a serving Judge of the Supreme Court or a High Court or a serving Member of any service of the Central Government or State Government or their undertaking, he shall either resign or obtain voluntary retirement from his parent service before joining the Tribunal.

Tenure

As per Section 17 (1) (a) of the Tribunal Reforms Act, 2026, Presiding Officer of a DRT shall hold office for a term of five years or till he attains the age of seventy years, whichever is earlier.

Enclosures

  • Bio-data in the proforma at Annexure-I
  • Certificate to be furnished by the employer/head of office/forwarding authority as in Annexure-II (wherever applicable)
  • Clear photocopies of the up-to-date CR/APAR dossier of the officer containing CR/APARs of at least last five years i.e. from 2021-22 to 2025-26 duly attested by a Group A officer (in case ACR/APAR for a period more than 3 months is not recorded, then ACRs/APARs prior to five years for matching period along with No Report Certificate may be submitted)
  • Cadre clearance (in case of serving candidates)
  • Integrity certificate/clearance from vigilance and disciplinary angle as in Annexure III (in case of serving candidates)
  • Statement giving details of major or minor penalties, if any, imposed on the officer during the last ten years

Selection Process

The Search-Cum-Section Committee constituted under the Tribunal Reforms Act 2021 for recommending names for appointment to the said post shall scrutinise, or cause to be scrutinized, the applications with respect to suitability of application for the posts by giving due weightage to qualification and experience of candidates and shortlist candidates for conducting personal interaction. The final selection will be done on the basis of overall evaluation of candidates done by the Committee based on the qualification, experience and personal interaction.

Event Date
Date of Notification 01.10.2026 (Corrigendum dated 10.10.2026)
Last Date for Receipt of Applications 09.11.2026 up to 5:00 PM
Cut-off Date for Unforeseen Vacancies 30.04.2027

Important Instructions

  • No TA/DA will be admissible to the candidates to be called for interview/interaction. The candidates are required to make their own arrangements.
  • Any incomplete application or application received after due date will not be entertained.
  • The Department will not be responsible for postal delays or loss of application for reasons whatsoever.
  • Candidates must ensure that applications reach well within the stipulated closing date.
  • If an appointed Chairperson or Member is a serving Judge of the Supreme Court or High Court or a serving Member of an organized service, he shall resign or obtain voluntary retirement before joining.

What Are State PSC Jobs?

State PSC jobs are government recruitment opportunities notified through State Public Service Commissions. These commissions recruit candidates for various posts and services under state government departments according to the rules applicable to each recruitment.

State PSC recruitment is not limited to State Civil Services examinations. Public Service Commissions may also recruit candidates for engineering, medical, teaching, agriculture, legal, scientific, technical, administrative and other departmental posts.

The posts available depend on vacancies reported by the respective state government departments and the recruitment notifications issued by the commission.

Popular Posts Recruited Through State PSCs

State Public Service Commissions recruit candidates for a wide range of government posts. Common recruitment categories may include:

  • State Civil Services
  • Administrative Services
  • Assistant Commissioner
  • Assistant Director
  • Assistant Professor
  • Lecturer
  • Medical Officer
  • Veterinary Officer
  • Assistant Engineer
  • Assistant Executive Engineer
  • Agriculture Officer
  • Food Safety Officer
  • Drug Inspector
  • Scientific Officer
  • Law Officer
  • Labour Officer
  • Revenue-related Posts
  • Technical Officers
  • Departmental Officers

The actual posts available vary by commission and recruitment notification.

PSC Jobs by Group (Group 1, 2, 2A, 4 & Others)

Several State Public Service Commissions including TNPSC, APPSC, and TSPSC classify recruitment into numbered "Groups" based on post seniority, pay scale, and administrative responsibility. Understanding these groups helps candidates identify which exam to prepare for based on their qualification and career goals.

Group Typical Posts Minimum Qualification Selection Stages
Group 1 Deputy Collector, DSP, Assistant Commissioner, District Registrar Bachelor's degree Prelims + Mains + Interview
Group 2 Assistant Section Officer, Tehsildar, Municipal Commissioner (Grade), Block Development Officer Bachelor's degree Prelims + Mains (some states include Interview)
Group 2A Junior Assistant, Bill Collector, Field Surveyor Bachelor's degree Written Exam (Certificate Verification)
Group 3 Various department Grade II/Non-Gazetted posts Varies by post Written Exam
Group 4 Junior Assistant, Typist, Steno-Typist, Bill Collector, Record Clerk, Village Administrative Officer (VAO) SSLC / 10th or 12th pass (varies by post) Single Written Exam (Certificate Verification)

Group numbering, post names, and minimum qualifications vary by state the table above reflects the common pattern used by TNPSC-style classification. Some states use different group labels or don't use numbered groups at all. Always confirm the exact group structure and eligibility on your state PSC's official notification.

Who Should Apply for Group 4?

Group 4 posts are typically entry-level government jobs open to candidates who have completed SSLC (10th) or Higher Secondary (12th), making them one of the most accessible and high-demand categories of PSC recruitment. These posts don't usually require a specific degree, have a single-stage written exam, and see some of the highest applicant volumes of any PSC exam due to the lower qualification bar and large number of annual vacancies.

State PSC Eligibility Criteria

There is no single eligibility rule for all State PSC jobs. Qualification, age limit, experience and other conditions differ depending on the commission and post.

Eligibility Criteria General Guidance
Educational Qualification Depends on the post and may include Diploma, Graduation, Engineering, Medicine, Law, Post Graduation or another prescribed qualification.
Age Limit Minimum and maximum age limits vary by commission and recruitment.
Age Relaxation Relaxation may be available to eligible categories according to the rules applicable to the recruitment.
State / Domicile Conditions State-specific eligibility, reservation, language or residency conditions may apply to certain recruitments.
Experience Some technical, teaching, specialist or senior posts require relevant professional experience.
Number of Attempts Attempt restrictions apply only where specifically prescribed for an examination or recruitment.

Important: Candidates should check the detailed recruitment notification before applying because eligibility conditions differ for every State PSC recruitment.

State PSC Selection Process

The State PSC selection process depends on the commission and the type of post. There is no single selection procedure followed for every PSC recruitment.

Depending on the recruitment, the selection process may include one or more of the following stages:

  • Preliminary Examination
  • Main Examination
  • Written Examination
  • Screening Test
  • Subject-specific Examination
  • Skill Test
  • Physical Test
  • Interview / Personality Test
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

State Civil Services examinations may have Preliminary, Main and Interview stages, while technical, medical, teaching and departmental recruitment may follow a different selection process.

Always check the individual recruitment notification for the exact examination and selection procedure.

How to Apply for State PSC Jobs 2026

The application process differs slightly between commissions, but candidates can generally follow these steps:

  1. Find the required State PSC recruitment from the latest jobs table above.
  2. Open the detailed recruitment page.
  3. Check the post name, vacancies, qualification, age limit, application fee and important dates.
  4. Read the official recruitment notification carefully.
  5. Open the official application website or application link.
  6. Complete registration or One-Time Registration if required by the commission.
  7. Enter the required personal, educational and category details.
  8. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting documents.
  9. Pay the application fee if applicable.
  10. Review the application before final submission.
  11. Submit the application before the specified last date.
  12. Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

Candidates should submit applications only through the application method specified in the official notification.

State PSC Exam Pattern and Syllabus

There is no common exam pattern or syllabus for all State PSC recruitments.

State Civil Services examinations generally cover broader subjects such as General Studies and state-specific topics, while technical, medical, engineering, teaching and departmental recruitment may focus more heavily on subjects related to the post.

The following can differ between recruitments:

  • Number of papers
  • Objective or descriptive examination
  • Total marks
  • Exam duration
  • Negative marking
  • Minimum qualifying marks
  • Language requirements
  • Subject-specific syllabus
  • Interview or skill test requirements

Candidates should refer to the syllabus and exam pattern issued for the specific State PSC recruitment they are applying for.

State PSC Jobs vs UPSC Jobs

State Public Service Commissions and the Union Public Service Commission conduct different recruitment processes.

State PSC UPSC
Conducts recruitment for posts and services connected with the respective state. Conducts recruitment and examinations for various Union Government and All India Services posts.
Recruitment rules differ from one State PSC to another. Recruitment is conducted under the rules applicable to UPSC examinations and vacancies.
May recruit for State Civil Services, engineering, medical, teaching, technical and departmental posts. Conducts Civil Services Examination and various other recruitment examinations for Union Government posts.

Candidates looking for Union Government recruitment through UPSC can visit the UPSC Jobs page.

PSC vs PCS - What Is the Difference?

PSC stands for Public Service Commission. It refers to the constitutional commission responsible for conducting recruitment for various government posts and services within its jurisdiction.

PCS commonly refers to Provincial Civil Service or State Civil Services posts and examinations.

A State Public Service Commission may conduct a State Civil Services or PCS examination, but it can also conduct recruitment for many other positions such as Medical Officer, Assistant Engineer, Lecturer, Agriculture Officer and departmental posts.

Therefore, State PSC Jobs covers a broader range of recruitment than only PCS or State Civil Services examinations.

How to Choose the Right State PSC Recruitment

Before applying for a State PSC vacancy, candidates should compare the recruitment requirements with their qualification and preferences.

Check the following details:

  • Required educational qualification
  • Age limit
  • Category and reservation conditions
  • State or language requirements, if any
  • Number of vacancies
  • Pay scale or salary
  • Job location
  • Application fee
  • Selection process
  • Examination pattern
  • Application deadline

Apply only after confirming that you meet the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official recruitment notification.

State PSC Recruitment Updates You Should Check

A recruitment notification can sometimes be followed by additional notices from the commission. Candidates should continue checking recruitment updates even after submitting their application.

Important updates may include:

  • Application date extension
  • Correction window
  • Vacancy revision
  • Exam date
  • Exam city information
  • Admit card
  • Answer key
  • Result
  • Interview schedule
  • Document verification schedule
  • Final selection result

Relevant updates should be linked from the individual recruitment page whenever they are released.

Why Check State PSC Jobs on OnlyJobs?

OnlyJobs brings State Public Service Commission recruitment information together in one place so candidates can quickly find current opportunities without checking multiple commission websites individually.

For each recruitment, candidates can find important details such as:

  • Recruiting commission
  • Post name
  • Total vacancies
  • Educational qualification
  • Age limit
  • Salary or pay scale
  • Application fee
  • Selection process
  • Application dates
  • Official notification
  • Official application link

Recruitment information should be checked against the official State Public Service Commission notification before publication. Important corrections, vacancy revisions and date extensions should also be updated whenever they are released.

Latest State PSC Notifications - Frequently Asked Questions

What are State PSC Jobs?

State PSC Jobs are government recruitment opportunities notified through State Public Service Commissions for various posts and services under state government departments.

Which State PSC jobs are currently open?

Currently open recruitments are listed in the Latest State PSC Jobs 2026 table at the top of this page. The list is updated when new recruitment notifications and application updates are released.

Where can I find the latest State PSC recruitment notifications?

You can check the latest State PSC recruitment notifications on this page or select your commission from the State-wise PSC Jobs section to find recruitment specific to your state.

What qualification is required for State PSC jobs?

There is no single qualification required for all State PSC jobs. Depending on the post, candidates may need a Diploma, Graduation, Engineering degree, Medical qualification, Law degree, Post Graduation or another specified qualification.

Are all State PSC jobs for graduates?

No. Eligibility depends on the individual recruitment. Many administrative posts require a degree, while technical, professional and departmental posts may have different qualification requirements.

What is the age limit for State PSC jobs?

The minimum and maximum age limits vary according to the commission and post. Candidates should check the age criteria given in the individual recruitment notification.

Is age relaxation available for State PSC recruitment?

Age relaxation may be available to eligible categories according to the rules applicable to the respective recruitment. The exact relaxation should be checked in the official notification.

Is domicile compulsory for State PSC jobs?

Not for every State PSC recruitment. Some vacancies may have state-specific residency, reservation, language or other eligibility requirements. Candidates should check the relevant recruitment rules before applying.

What is the selection process for State PSC jobs?

The selection process varies by post. It may include a Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, written test, screening test, skill test, interview, physical test, document verification or medical examination.

Do all State PSC recruitments have Prelims and Mains?

No. Prelims and Mains are common in some State Civil Services examinations, but many technical, medical, teaching and departmental recruitments follow a different examination or selection process.

How can I apply for State PSC recruitment?

Open the required recruitment from the latest jobs table, read the eligibility and application details, check the official notification and use the official application link provided on the recruitment page.

What is the difference between State PSC and UPSC?

State PSCs conduct recruitment mainly for posts and services connected with their respective states, while UPSC conducts recruitment and examinations for various Union Government and All India Services posts.

Is PSC the same as PCS?

No. PSC means Public Service Commission, while PCS generally refers to Provincial Civil Service or State Civil Services. A State PSC can recruit for PCS as well as many other administrative, technical, medical and departmental posts.

Where can I check State PSC admit cards?

When an admit card is released, the related recruitment page should be updated with the admit card information and official download link. Candidates can also check the OnlyJobs Admit Card section.

Where can I check State PSC results?

State PSC result updates can be checked through the individual recruitment page or the OnlyJobs Results section.

How often is this State PSC Jobs page updated?

The page is updated when new State PSC recruitment notifications, application extensions and other important recruitment updates become available.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

How to Apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026

Candidates can submit the Anganwadi Form 2026 online or offline according to the instructions in the specific recruitment advertisement. There is no single online application process for every state.

  2. Open the detailed notification and verify the last date.

  4. Follow the official online application link or obtain the prescribed offline form.
  5. Complete the required information and submit the specified documents.
  6. Pay the application fee only if required by the notification.
  7. Submit before the closing deadline and retain the acknowledgement or submission record where provided.

Photograph, signature and other supporting certificates should be prepared in the format prescribed by the authority. The exact document list must be checked before applying.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 FAQs

What is the last date for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?

There is no common last date for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026. Each state or district publishes its own closing date. Check the live recruitment table for the applicable notification.

Where can I apply for Anganwadi jobs online in 2026?

Apply through the official state or district recruitment portal mentioned in the specific advertisement. Some Anganwadi recruitments require offline applications instead.

Is Anganwadi Supervisor Vacancy 2026 available?

Supervisor vacancies are announced separately by the relevant recruitment authorities. Candidates should confirm an active Supervisor notification before applying.

What is the last date for Anganwadi Supervisor Vacancy 2026?

The last date depends on the state and the Supervisor advertisement. Worker and Helper application deadlines do not automatically apply to Supervisor posts.

Can 10th or 12th pass candidates apply for Anganwadi jobs?

Yes, some Anganwadi Worker and Helper notifications accept Class 10 or Class 12 qualifications. The required qualification depends on the post and recruiting authority.

Is there an examination for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?

The selection method depends on the official notification. Candidates should check whether the recruitment involves academic merit, a written examination, interview or other prescribed stages.

How can I find Anganwadi Vacancy 2026 in Haryana or Telangana?

Check the state-wise recruitment section and open the relevant district notification. Verify the post, vacancy, deadline and application mode before applying.

Where can I find Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 in Maharashtra?

Check the relevant Maharashtra Women and Child Development or district recruitment notification for Anganwadi Sevika, Helper and Supervisor vacancies, as applicable.

Is wcd.gov.in the Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 official website?

The central Ministry of Women and Child Development website is wcd.gov.in. Recruitment application portals differ by state and district, so applicants must use the portal specified in their notification.

Can I apply for an Anganwadi vacancy in another district?

That depends on the recruitment's residence and eligibility rules. Some Worker and Helper notices require candidates to belong to a particular village, ward or project area.

Forest Guard Recruitment 2026 - Latest Vacancies & Eligibility

Forest Guard recruitment is suitable for candidates interested in forest protection, patrolling and field-level government work. Forest Guard vacancies are generally announced by state forest departments or authorized recruitment boards.

What does a Forest Guard do?

A Forest Guard helps protect forest areas, monitor activities, assist with wildlife conservation and report suspected forest offences. Duties can include patrolling assigned forest areas and supporting senior forest officials.

What is the qualification for Forest Guard Recruitment 2026?

Some Forest Guard recruitments require Class 10 or Class 12 qualifications from a recognized board. However, the exact educational requirements depend on the state and recruitment notification.

Candidates should check:

  • Education: Required qualification and recognized board.
  • Age Limit: Minimum and maximum age, including the age-calculation date.
  • Physical Standards: Height, chest measurements or other applicable requirements.
  • Selection Process: Written examination, physical tests or other notified stages.
  • Vacancies: Total and category-wise posts.
  • Application Dates: Registration opening and closing dates.

How can I apply for Forest Guard Vacancy 2026?

Find the Forest Guard recruitment in the vacancy table above, open the detailed notification, confirm eligibility and follow the official application instructions.

Candidates should apply only through the website or submission method prescribed by the recruiting authority.

Forest Range Officer Recruitment 2026 - RFO Jobs

Forest Range Officer Recruitment 2026 provides opportunities for candidates interested in forest administration, conservation and supervisory roles.

A Forest Range Officer, also referred to as a Range Forest Officer or RFO in some recruitment systems, may oversee forest protection activities, supervise field staff and manage responsibilities within an assigned forest range.

What is the qualification for Forest Range Officer recruitment?

Forest Range Officer recruitment generally involves graduate-level eligibility. Some notifications require degrees in specified subjects such as science, agriculture, forestry or other approved disciplines.

The accepted qualifications vary by recruiting organization. A graduation degree alone does not automatically make a candidate eligible for every RFO vacancy.

How are Forest Range Officers selected?

Depending on the recruitment rules, selection may include:

  • Preliminary or main written examinations
  • Physical standards or fitness assessments
  • Interviews, where prescribed
  • Document verification
  • Medical examination

Candidates searching for RFO Vacancy 2026, Forest Ranger Recruitment or Forest Range Service Officer notifications should check the relevant vacancy details for exact eligibility and selection stages.

Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for Forest Department jobs depends on the post, department and recruitment rules.

Educational Qualification

These are general patterns, not fixed nationwide eligibility criteria.

What is the age limit for Forest Department jobs?

There is no common age limit for all Forest Department recruitment in India.

Each notification specifies the minimum age, maximum age, applicable cut-off date and age-relaxation rules.

Candidates belonging to reserved categories, including eligible ex-servicemen, should check the provisions applicable to their recruitment.

Is a physical test compulsory for Forest Department jobs?

Physical standards and fitness assessments are common in certain field-level posts, particularly Forest Guard and some officer-level recruitment.

However, not every Forest Department post has a physical test. Technical, administrative and other positions may follow different selection procedures.

Where physical testing is required, the official notification specifies the standards, test format and qualifying conditions.

How to Apply for Forest Department Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online or offline according to the instructions issued for the specific vacancy.

Application process

  1. Choose a vacancy: Find a suitable Forest Department job in the recruitment table.
  2. Check eligibility: Verify the qualification, age limit, physical requirements and other conditions.
  3. Read the notification: Review the official recruitment PDF and important instructions.
  4. Open the application link: Visit the authorized recruitment portal or follow the offline application procedure.
  5. Complete the form: Enter the required personal, educational and contact details.
  6. Submit documents: Upload or attach the prescribed certificates and photographs.
  7. Pay the fee: Complete payment if the notification requires an application fee.
  8. Submit the application: Review the details and complete submission before the deadline.
  9. Save confirmation: Keep the acknowledgment or completed application for future reference.

Which documents are required?

The required documents vary by recruitment. Applicants may need educational certificates, identity proof, photograph, signature, category certificates, domicile documents or other eligibility records.

Always follow the document list and format requirements mentioned in the official notification.

Forest Department Selection Process 2026

How are candidates selected for Forest Department jobs?

Recruiting organizations use different selection methods based on the post. Some Forest Guard and officer-level vacancies include written examinations and physical tests, while technical or administrative roles may involve skill tests or interviews.

Selection Stage What Candidates Should Know
Written Examination Tests knowledge or skills specified in the official syllabus
Physical Standard Test (PST) Checks prescribed physical measurements
Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Assesses fitness through notified activities
Skill Test / Interview Conducted when required for the position
Document Verification Confirms qualifications and eligibility documents
Medical Examination Checks medical fitness where prescribed

Not every candidate will undergo every stage. The official recruitment notice determines the actual selection procedure and the basis for preparing the merit list.

What is the Forest Guard exam syllabus?

Where a written examination is required, the syllabus may cover General Knowledge, Current Affairs, General Science, Mathematics, Reasoning, environmental topics or state-specific subjects.

Candidates should follow the syllabus and examination pattern published for their particular Forest Guard or Forest Range Officer recruitment.

Forest Department Jobs Salary 2026

How much salary do Forest Department employees receive?

Forest Department salaries depend on the post, state, pay scale, appointment category and service rules.

For example, a Forest Guard's pay may differ from that of a Forester, Range Forest Officer or Assistant Conservator of Forests.

Regular positions may carry a prescribed pay level and allowances, while contractual or project-based posts may offer fixed monthly remuneration.

Before applying, check:

  • Basic pay or consolidated remuneration
  • Pay level and salary scale
  • Applicable allowances
  • Probation or contract terms
  • Other service conditions

The official recruitment notification is the correct source for the salary of a specific vacancy.

Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Official Notification & Application Website

There is no single national application website for all state Forest Department jobs.

Recruitment may be handled by a state Forest Department, Public Service Commission, staff selection board or another authorized organization.

To locate the correct official website:

  1. Find your preferred vacancy in the recruitment table.
  2. Open its detailed job notification.
  3. Check the name of the recruiting authority.
  4. Open the official notification PDF.
  5. Follow the application link or instructions provided by the recruiting authority.

OnlyJobs publishes recruitment information to help candidates find opportunities. The official recruiting organization remains the authoritative source for eligibility, deadlines, results and application procedures.

Candidates looking for वन विभाग वैकेंसी 2026, वन रक्षक भर्ती, Forest Guard Bharti or वन विभाग ऑनलाइन फॉर्म can use the recruitment list above to find relevant notifications.
